document_api_meta.title: Recommend Required Product Properties
document_api_meta.env_desc:
Predicts the required product properties and their recommended values from the product category and content. The result is generated synchronously for one product and can be used to prepare a create or edit product request.

Do not include personal data, such as names, phone numbers, email addresses, or postal addresses, in the product title, description, or images. The response does not return the submitted product content.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc: Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.

request_body_param.name: category_id
request_body_param.desc: The ID of the leaf category selected for the product.

request_body_param.name: description
request_body_param.desc: Product description used to improve prediction accuracy. Do not include personal data.

request_body_param.name: images
request_body_param.desc: Ordered product images used to improve prediction accuracy. Do not include images containing personal data.

request_body_param.name: ^uri
request_body_param.desc: URI of a product image previously uploaded to TikTok Shop.

request_body_param.name: product_title
request_body_param.desc: Product title used to predict required properties. Do not include personal data.

request_body_param.name: sales_properties
request_body_param.desc: Existing standard sales properties that define the product variants and provide additional prediction context.

request_body_param.name: ^values
request_body_param.desc: Existing values selected for the sales property.

request_body_param.name: ^^id
request_body_param.desc: ID of the sales property value.

request_body_param.name: target_property_ids
request_body_param.desc: Optional property IDs that limit prediction to specific properties. When omitted, no property ID filter is applied.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: ^recommended_properties
response_param.desc: Ordered required properties predicted for the product. The array is empty when no property recommendation is available.

response_param.name: ^^is_customizable
response_param.desc: Whether the seller can enter a custom value when no recommended value applies.

response_param.name: ^^is_multiple_selection
response_param.desc: Whether the seller can select more than one value for the property.

response_param.name: ^^is_required
response_param.desc: Whether the property must be provided when the product is created or edited.

response_param.name: ^^name
response_param.desc: Display name of the recommended property for the shop's region.

response_param.name: ^^type
response_param.desc:
Type of the recommended property.
Possible values:
- `UNSPECIFIED`: The service could not classify the property type.
- `KEY_PROPERTY`: A key property used to identify the product.
- `SALES_PROPERTY`: A sales property that defines product variants.
- `PRODUCT_PROPERTY`: A property that describes the product as a whole.

response_param.name: ^^values
response_param.desc: Ordered values recommended for the property. The array is empty when the property requires a custom value or no value is recommended.

response_param.name: ^^^id
response_param.desc: ID of the recommended property value.

response_param.name: ^^^name
response_param.desc: Display name of the recommended property value for the shop's region.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
